title: Conjectures of Ashoke Sen: Scope, Exact Tests and Analytic Limits: manuscript, exact computations and scoped formal checks
description: Single-column research revision of a selected survey, with corrected charge cone and 30-entry exact scan, a precise dust focusing statement, the base/cover divisor distinction, and a source-version audit. The infrared appendices construct a finite-energy soft model and derive a subtracted tree-emission cutoff bound, logarithmic tail formulas and an overlapping-limit obstruction. All three current Lean modules compile and pass kernel replay relative to imports; their 75 named audited statements have limited documented scopes. No new fatal error in corrected published proofs, full four-dimensional infrared closure or full-manuscript formalisation is claimed. Deep Bhattacharjee is the sole author.
